description: Get one auction by its auctionId: name, provider, format, schedule, reported status, reported and visible lot counts, and the link to its catalogue at the provider. Each result's `viewLink.url` is the provider link meant to be shared with people: it carries Aura Historia's referral tagging, which is lost when its query parameters are changed. `viewLink.affiliate` is `true` when that link is an affiliate link, which can earn Aura Historia a commission. `url` is the provider's untagged address.
name: getAuction
